scholarships.title: Barcelona School of Economics Master's Tuition Funding and Scholarships

eligibility: Applicant to a BSE Master's programme (Economics, Finance, Data Science, Public Policy, Competition and Regulation, Trade, Macroeconomics, Energy and Climate programmes)
No separate scholarship application is described for the named scholarships or the tuition waivers
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants admitted to a BSE Master's programme who have an outstanding academic record. Funding is awarded on academic merit, and only applicants with outstanding academic records will receive a financial offer. All applicants to the Economics and Finance Programs are considered for the Ramón Areces Foundation and Unicredit Foundation scholarships, and all applicants to all Master's programmes are considered for sponsor-provided tuition waivers.
benefits: Tuition-fee waivers covering 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of tuition fees
A limited number of fully-funded scholarships covering 100% of fees plus some additional stipend, depending on the scholarship
Ramón Areces Foundation Scholarships: 100% of tuition fees for the Economics or Finance Program
Unicredit Foundation Masterscholarships: one full scholarship for the Economics or Finance Program
Additional full or partial tuition waivers from Aena, Sabadell and Repsol Fundación sponsors for all Master's programmes
BSE awards an average of €550,000 in merit-based funding each year, with around 24% of matriculated students fully or partially funded
requirements: Create an account in the BSE application system
Complete the application questions, including finance and scholarship details
Upload all required documents before submitting
Have both referees upload their signed letters: 'Your application is not considered complete until both letters have been uploaded'
Pay the €100 application fee by credit card or Flywire; it is non-refundable
documents: Undergraduate academic transcripts or mark sheets
Proof of English level (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or Cambridge)
Two reference letters uploaded directly by the referees
Signed declaration of expected degree if the undergraduate degree is not yet complete
GRE score if applying to the PhD Track Program
existing.english_requirement: TOEFL 90, IELTS Academic 6.5, Duolingo English Test minimum 120, or Cambridge Proficiency/Advanced minimum 176 (B2–C2). Proof is not required for native English speakers or those who did their undergraduate degree at an English-speaking university.
application_method: Create an account in the BSE Application System at apply.bse.eu
Complete the application questions and upload the required documents
Pay the application fee and submit
Admissions decision and any financial aid offer are delivered together by email
existing.selection_notes: Funding is based on academic merit: 'Only applicants with outstanding academic records will receive a financial offer.' First-round applicants are considered for all funding opportunities; later applicants only for remaining funds.
existing.best_fit: Candidates with an outstanding academic record and a strong quantitative background applying to a BSE Master's programme before the 15 January funding cut-off.
existing.notes: Published 2027-28 tuition fees are €18,500 for all programmes other than the Data Science programmes, which are €20,000, and 'they do not cover housing or living expenses'. The application fee is €100 and non-refundable. GRE is required only for the PhD Track Program.
existing.duration: One Master's programme cycle; funding is assessed with the admission offer.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle with a funding priority cut-off of 15 January for the intake starting the following autumn. The contact form on the page lists intake interests of 2027-2028 and 2028-2029, so the next cycle is being prepared but no calendar date is published.
existing.deadline_display: Applications for 2026-27 intake are now closed. Candidates who submit a completed application before January 15 will be considered for all funding opportunities; those who apply after that date will be considered for any remaining available funding. First-round applicants can expect an admissions decision by the middle of February; later applicants receive a decision within approximately 5 weeks.
existing.program_type: Merit-based tuition-fee waivers and named full scholarships for BSE Master's students
